m13.text: Bazzle wakes to a cry of alarm and realizes that his clockwork creation has escaped again, and he finds a crude brass arm on his workbench made of melted keys.
He realizes the creature has learned its creator's trade and become his apprentice, but when he tries to dislodge its chest key, it winds itself and strikes him in the face.
On the third morning he finds his good arm severed and the metal arm attached in its place, and he realizes the creature never wanted a companion or army, only to stop sharing a body with him.
The creature takes a cleaver, beheads Bazzle and sets its own head in his place, completing itself.
